en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Hisham Bin Salim, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said, ‘
I heard him<sup>asws</sup> saying: ‘The one who eats a Pomegranate upon the empty stomach, illuminates his heart for forty days’.
en.sarwar: 11. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘Umayr from Hisham ibn Salim who has said the following: “I once heard abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, saying, ‘
If one eats a pomegranate before breakfast his heart remains bright for forty days.’”
